roleLabel: Rush bruiser Vanguard — stacks Max HP from Rampage and refreshes Rush when adjacent fights go lethal
bestFor: Max HP / Rush boards that want a sticky frontliner who snowballs through the run
strength: Rampage stacks Max HP/AS/Omnivamp; Bloodthirsty refreshes Rush when he or an adjacent enemy dips low — long fights favor him
weakness: Needs adjacency and Rush uptime; isolated or Rush-starved Rip is just a slow HP bag

howToPlay.early: Solid front pickup. Buy Max HP immediately. Get at least one Rush piece so Bloodthirsty and Rampage have a loop.
howToPlay.mid: Glutton = permanent Max HP on Rush (Backup shares to Vanguards). Enraged/Rampage path = stacking rage carry. Brute = Crit lifesteal. Pick tribal HP, selfish stacks, or Crit sustain.
howToPlay.late: Titanic/Frenzy Vanguard relics and Rush banners. Keep enemies adjacent so the refresh clause can fire.
howToPlay.positioning: Front row with enemies next to him. Bloodthirsty cares about adjacent lethal thresholds — empty wings waste refreshes.

abilityNotes.Rampage: Stacking rage — each cast thickens Max HP and fight stats. Cast early and often; the stacks are the point.

specNotes.The Glutton: Take with Vanguard tribal so Backup Max HP spreads. Solo Rip may still like it for personal HP, but tribal multiplies value.
specNotes.The Enraged: Rampage/Bloodthirsty carry identity — default when Rip is your main front DPS.
specNotes.The Brute: Crit lifesteal path. Take when Crit relics are already flowing.

relicReasons.vanguards-titanic-engine-4002: Max HP engine that matches Rampage stacking.
relicReasons.vanguards-frenzy-prism-3004: Frenzy/Rush tempo for refreshes and rage uptime.
relicReasons.vanguards-rally-banner-538: Rush rally tools keep Bloodthirsty relevant.

faq.question: Is Rip good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Strong sticky Rush frontliner. Weak if he never adjacent-fights or never hits Rush. Buy him to snowball HP in the pit, not to snipe.

faq.question: What class is Rip?
faq.answer: Vanguard. Role focus: high-health Rush bruiser with adjacent Rush refreshes.

faq.question: What relics work with Rip?
faq.answer: Vanguard Titanic/Frenzy/Rally pieces, Max HP amplifiers, and Crit tools for Brute.

faq.question: How do you play Rip?
faq.answer: Front him into clumps, stack Max HP and Rush, cast Rampage early, and specialize toward Glutton tribal HP or Enraged carry.

tips: If refreshes never happen, check adjacency — Bloodthirsty is a placement keyword.
Glutton Backup wants friends; three Vanguards beats solo greed.
